title: African American Toddler in Bonnet on Tricycle, 1950s Vintage Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription: my niece Shirley R. Floyd at the age of 17 months
description: A charming outdoor portrait capturing seventeen-month-old Shirley R. Floyd seated atop a metal tricycle on a grassy lawn. She is dressed in an oversized white sunbonnet, a light-colored ruffled baby frock, ankle socks, and dark buckle shoes. The background reveals a residential yard with trees and soft foliage, capturing a tender everyday moment of mid-century African American family life.
